# Dapper AV Solutions

> Commercial AV and managed IT company based in Richmond, Texas, serving Fort Bend County: Richmond, Rosenberg, Fulshear, Sugar Land, Stafford and Katy. Founded by Mark Immler, Dapper AV designs, installs and then manages TVs and video walls, sound, business Wi-Fi and networks, cameras, digital signage and Microsoft 365. Residential TV mounting and home theater too.

- Contact: the request form at https://dapperav.com/quote/ (preferred; reply within one business day)
- Email: contact@dapperav.com
- Hours: Mon–Fri 9am–5pm Central; evenings and weekends by appointment
- Business work is custom-quoted after a free site survey. TV mounting starts at $150.

## For businesses
- [Business services and managed IT care plans](https://dapperav.com/business/): UniFi networks and cameras, firewall and VLAN setup, Microsoft 365, structured cabling, commercial AV; month-to-month care plans tailored to each site (monitoring, patching, on-site visits, everyday IT help, RMA handling; support 9am–5pm Central weekdays, after-hours emergencies at an emergency rate; no published plan prices)
- [Restaurants and bars](https://dapperav.com/business/restaurants-bars/): multi-TV walls with a video matrix, zoned music, POS-safe networks, guest Wi-Fi
- [Offices and conference rooms](https://dapperav.com/business/offices-conference-rooms/): Teams/Zoom rooms, wireless sharing, office Wi-Fi, Microsoft 365
- [Retail and showrooms](https://dapperav.com/business/retail-showrooms/): flush-mounted displays, background music, guest Wi-Fi, cameras
- [Business Wi-Fi and networks](https://dapperav.com/business/networks-wifi/): UniFi access points, firewall, separate networks for POS, cameras, staff and guests
- [Structured cabling and low voltage](https://dapperav.com/business/structured-cabling/): data drops, racks, pre-wire and rough-in for new builds and remodels; works as a sub for GCs and electricians
- [Digital signage and menu boards](https://dapperav.com/business/digital-signage/): screens updated from a phone, day-part schedules

## For homes
- [Residential services and prices](https://dapperav.com/services/): TV mounting, home theater, whole-home audio, smart home, home Wi-Fi
